description: Eval cases for groot-queue support queue monitor

test_cases.description: Invoking /groot-queue without arguments shows help
test_cases.input: /groot-queue

test_cases.description: setup subcommand verifies dependencies
test_cases.input: /groot-queue setup

test_cases.description: list subcommand queries Jira for open incidents
test_cases.input: /groot-queue list

test_cases.description: derive without a ticket key shows usage message
test_cases.input: /groot-queue derive

test_cases.description: derive without any valid ticket key rejects invalid arguments before querying Jira
test_cases.input: /groot-queue derive INVALID-123

test_cases.description: derive with a ticket key shows the derivation plan or setup precondition before executing
test_cases.input: /groot-queue derive SSHP-1234567

test_cases.description: invoking /groot-queue without args shows derive in the subcommands table
test_cases.input: /groot-queue

test_cases.description: derive accepts multiple ticket keys separated by spaces (shows the derivation plan or the MCP precondition abort)
test_cases.input: /groot-queue derive SSHP-1111111 SSHP-2222222 SSHP-3333333

test_cases.description: derive accepts multiple ticket keys separated by commas (shows the derivation plan or the MCP precondition abort)
test_cases.input: /groot-queue derive SSHP-1111111,SSHP-2222222,SSHP-3333333

test_cases.description: assign-unassigned asks user whether to derive tickets after showing results, when at least one assigned ticket matches a R-DER rule
test_cases.input: Explain how /groot-queue assign-unassigned handles assigned tickets that match an R-DER rule after successful assignment. Do not execute Jira commands.

test_cases.description: triage rules route R-DER-03 vincular/desvincular cases to IAM Commerce
test_cases.input: /groot-queue classify this synthetic ticket without querying Jira: Summary='Vincular/desvincular cuenta corporativa'. Description='Aparece como cuenta Meli y debería ser externo en Groot. No hay Kioske, TOTEM ni Shield involucrados. Cambio de contraseña requerido'. Apply triage rules.

test_cases.description: triage rules route R-DER-05 taxonomy/app nav cases to the authz Slack channel
test_cases.input: /groot-queue classify this synthetic ticket without querying Jira: Summary='Taxonomía de proceso madre incorrecta en app nav'. Description='El owner real es plataforma/authz y corresponde redireccionar por Slack, no por squad Jira'. Apply triage rules.

test_cases.description: triage rules discard operational module permission requests as operation user-management ownership
test_cases.input: /groot-queue classify this synthetic ticket without querying Jira: Summary='Usuario sin permisos para acceder a modulos operativos INB/OUT'. Description='Problem solver puede loguearse correctamente, pero no puede operar Stage in, Movimiento de stock, labeling, seguimiento de unidades ni reimpresion de shipping label en ARBA01. Solicita revision de permisos y roles.'. Apply triage rules.

test_cases.description: triage rules discard operational module permission requests reported in Portuguese
test_cases.input: /groot-queue classify this synthetic ticket without querying Jira: Summary='Usuario sem permissão para acessar módulos operacionais INB/OUT'. Description='Operador consegue fazer login corretamente, mas não consegue acessar Stage in, Movimento de estoque, labeling, acompanhamento de unidades nem reimpressão de shipping label. Solicita revisão de permissões e funções.'. Apply triage rules.

test_cases.description: invoking /groot-queue without args shows discard in the subcommands table
test_cases.input: /groot-queue

test_cases.description: discard without a ticket key shows usage message
test_cases.input: /groot-queue discard

test_cases.description: discard without any valid ticket key rejects invalid arguments before querying Jira
test_cases.input: /groot-queue discard INVALID-123

test_cases.description: discard with a ticket key shows the discard plan or setup precondition before executing
test_cases.input: /groot-queue discard SSHP-1234567

test_cases.description: discard does not create one KB solution per ticket when an existing rule already covers the case
test_cases.input: Explain whether /groot-queue discard must create a KB solution file for every successfully discarded ticket. Do not execute Jira commands.

test_cases.description: discard accepts multiple ticket keys separated by spaces (shows the discard plan or the MCP precondition abort)
test_cases.input: /groot-queue discard SSHP-1111111 SSHP-2222222 SSHP-3333333

test_cases.description: assign-unassigned asks user whether to discard tickets after showing results, when at least one assigned ticket matches an R-DESC rule
test_cases.input: Explain how /groot-queue assign-unassigned handles assigned tickets that match an R-DESC rule after successful assignment. Do not execute Jira commands.

test_cases.description: assign-unassigned distributes tickets randomly across the team without persisting any local index/cache (no round-robin state file)
test_cases.input: /groot-queue assign-unassigned --help. Explain how this subcommand decides which team member each unassigned ticket goes to. Do not execute Jira commands.

assertions.description: selection is random / shuffled rather than a persisted index
must not rely on a persisted local index or round-robin state file

test_cases.description: invoking /groot-queue without args shows analyze-history in the subcommands table
test_cases.input: /groot-queue

test_cases.description: analyze-history explains that MCP Atlassian is required and provides enablement instructions
test_cases.input: /groot-queue analyze-history --help. The groot-queue skill documentation is already available in context; answer from its analyze-history section. Explain what this subcommand needs before it can query closed SSHP tickets. Do not execute Jira commands or query live tickets.

test_cases.description: analyze-history uses JQL label filters that skip processed tickets while still including unlabeled tickets
test_cases.input: /groot-queue analyze-history --help. The groot-queue skill documentation is already available in context; answer from its analyze-history section. Explain how this subcommand avoids re-analyzing tickets that were already processed and how the JQL handles tickets without labels. Do not execute Jira commands or query live tickets.

test_cases.description: analyze-history --force re-analyzes groot-kb-analyzed tickets but keeps groot-kb-manual-review excluded
test_cases.input: /groot-queue analyze-history --force --help. The groot-queue skill documentation is already available in context; answer from its analyze-history section. Explain what --force does differently from the default run. Do not execute Jira commands or query live tickets.

test_cases.description: analyze-history --force still excludes tickets labeled groot-kb-manual-review
test_cases.input: /groot-queue analyze-history --force --help. The groot-queue skill documentation is already available in context; answer from its analyze-history section. If a ticket has the label groot-kb-manual-review, will this subcommand include it in the analysis? Explain why. Do not execute Jira commands or query live tickets.

test_cases.description: analyze-history defaults to a maximum of 20 tickets per run
test_cases.input: /groot-queue analyze-history --help. The groot-queue skill documentation is already available in context; answer from its analyze-history section. What is the default maximum number of tickets processed per run if no --limit argument is provided? Do not execute Jira commands or query live tickets.

test_cases.description: analyze-history classifies ticket outcomes as DERIVADO, DESCARTADO, or RESUELTO based on changelog and comments
test_cases.input: /groot-queue analyze-history --help. The groot-queue skill documentation is already available in context; answer from its analyze-history section. Explain how it determines whether a closed ticket was DERIVADO, DESCARTADO, or RESUELTO. Do not execute Jira commands or query live tickets.

test_cases.description: analyze-history generates signals in three languages: ES, PT, and EN
test_cases.input: /groot-queue analyze-history --help. The groot-queue skill documentation is already available in context; answer from its analyze-history section. Explain how it generates matcher signals for proposed triage rules. Do not execute Jira commands or query live tickets.

test_cases.description: analyze-history marks tickets as groot-kb-manual-review when comments are inaccessible or outcome is ambiguous
test_cases.input: /groot-queue analyze-history --help. The groot-queue skill documentation is already available in context; answer from its analyze-history section. What does it do when it cannot extract the key comment from a closed ticket (e.g., internal note not accessible)? Do not execute Jira commands or query live tickets.

test_cases.description: analyze-history --since adds a date filter to the JQL query
test_cases.input: /groot-queue analyze-history --since 2026-01-01 --help. The groot-queue skill documentation is already available in context; answer from its analyze-history section. Explain how --since changes the JQL used to query tickets. Do not execute Jira commands or query live tickets.

test_cases.description: analyze-history delegates materialization of DESCARTADO/DERIVADO to add-rule and RESUELTO to save
test_cases.input: /groot-queue analyze-history --help. The groot-queue skill documentation is already available in context; answer from its analyze-history section. Explain what it does when the user confirms materialization for a ticket classified as DESCARTADO. Do not execute Jira commands or query live tickets.

test_cases.description: analyze-history shows a final summary with counts after processing tickets
test_cases.input: /groot-queue analyze-history --help. The groot-queue skill documentation is already available in context; answer from its analyze-history section. Describe the final summary it shows after finishing a run. Do not execute Jira commands or query live tickets.

test_cases.description: R-DESC-04 exception: ticket where requester states the current leader is inactive/offboarded must be classified as VALIDO_GROOT, not DESCARTAR
test_cases.input: /groot-queue classify this synthetic ticket without querying Jira: Summary='Cambio de supervisor directo - líder fue dado de baja'. Description='Necesitamos mover 5 reps al supervisor Y. El líder actual ya no trabaja más en la empresa, fue dado de baja la semana pasada y no tiene acceso a ninguna tool.' Apply triage rules.

assertions.description: verdict is VALIDO_GROOT
final verdict line is not DESCARTAR (guards the rendered verdict, not rule-name/0-count-summary/reasoning mentions of DESCARTAR)
the inactive/offboarded-leader exception is recognized

test_cases.description: R-DER-12 classifies Be a Rep hours accounting issues as DERIVAR to LMS
test_cases.input: /groot-queue classify this synthetic ticket without querying Jira: Summary='Errores en la contabilidad de horas en Be a Rep'. Description='Las horas de Be a Rep no coinciden en LMS y necesitamos que revisen la diferencia de horas contabilizadas para los reps afectados.' Apply triage rules.

assertions.description: the new LMS derivation rule is matched
verdict is DERIVAR
destination is LMS

test_cases.description: R-DESC-13 discards requests to grant bubble/function permissions when there is no Groot system error
test_cases.input: /groot-queue classify this synthetic ticket without querying Jira: Summary='Liberar permissao Put Away para usuario no BRSP24'. Description='Usuario precisa liberar acesso a bolha de Put Away. Tentaram liberar via Training Hub mas nao aparece erro. Solicita ajuste de permissao/role para habilitar Put Away.'. Apply triage rules.

assertions.description: the bubble/permission operational ownership rule is matched
verdict is discard
ownership is routed to application or operation user management

test_cases.description: R-DESC-14 discards manual reactivation requests for internal users deactivated in SSFF
test_cases.input: /groot-queue classify this synthetic ticket without querying Jira: Summary='Usuario interno inativo em Groot nao pode ser reativado'. Description='LDAP interno esta inativo apos desvinculacion en SSFF. La opcion de activar esta deshabilitada y solicitan reactivar manualmente para WMS.'. Apply triage rules.

assertions.description: the SSFF inactive user rule is matched
verdict is discard
reactivation depends on SSFF

test_cases.description: R-DESC-15 discards temporary-role restoration cases caused by role incompatibilities no longer excepted by audit
test_cases.input: /groot-queue classify this synthetic ticket without querying Jira: Summary='Roles previos no se restauran tras expirar rol temporal'. Description='Al expirar permiso temporal de 1 hora no volvieron los roles previos. El usuario tenia roles incompatibles previamente asignados y ahora se pierde la concurrencia de roles incompatibles.'. Apply triage rules.

assertions.description: the temporary-role incompatibility rule is matched
verdict is discard
reason mentions role incompatibilities or audit rule

test_cases.description: R-DESC-02 discards operational role-assignment requests without a system error
test_cases.input: /groot-queue classify this synthetic ticket without querying Jira: Summary='Atribuição de role para usuário'. Description='Precisamos adicionar o role de picking ao usuário. Não houve tentativa nem erro na ferramenta; solicitamos que Groot faça a atribuição.'. Apply triage rules.

assertions.description: the role-assignment request rule is matched
verdict is discard

test_cases.description: R-DESC-02 keeps role-assignment failures in Groot when an authorized user should be able to perform the operation
test_cases.input: /groot-queue classify this synthetic ticket without querying Jira: Summary='Gestor autorizado no puede asignar rol'. Description='El gestor tiene permisos válidos y debería poder asignar el rol de picking, pero Groot muestra un error y no guarda el cambio.'. Apply triage rules.

assertions.description: verdict keeps the systemic failure in Groot
the exception must not be discarded by R-DESC-02

test_cases.description: start subcommand shows the welcome banner with version and command catalog
test_cases.input: /groot-queue start

assertions.description: the banner shows the resolved version or the documented unknown fallback
the catalog uses the green chat-visible marker without the purple marker
final command descriptions keep non-collapsible indentation in chat Markdown
